resume.invalid: Invalid changes: {max} substitutions at most, 11 positions.

issues.incomplete: Incomplete eleven: put a player in each of the 11 positions before saving.

lineup.notInSquad: A player is no longer at your club: your line-up has been reloaded.
lineup.conflict: Your line-up was changed in another tab.

contracts.invalid: Invalid proposal: the length is 1 to 5 seasons.

choice.LEAVE: He will leave on a free at the end of the season.

contracts.choiceInvalid: Invalid choice: extend him, let him go, or leave it to your assistant.

market.invalid: Invalid proposal: the length is 1 to 5 seasons, and the fee is a whole amount in euros.
market.signed: Contract signed until {until}, signing bonus of {bonus}.
market.offerAccepted: Offer accepted: transfer for {fee}, contract until {until}.

objective.invalid: Unknown objective: choose one of the three the board offers.

refusals.season-started: Your first match of the season has been played: the objective can no longer be chosen.

saleProposals.keepRefused: Nothing to keep: the window is closed, or the player has left your squad.

refusals.insufficientBudget: Insufficient budget: your transfer budget doesn't cover this deal.

refusals.insufficientBudgetBonus: Your budget doesn't cover his signing bonus ({bonus}).

liveMatch.noMatchInProgress: No match is waiting to resume.
